name: Historic Sanctuary of Machu Picchu
description: Perched at 2,430 metres on a ridge of the eastern Andes in Peru, Machu Picchu is an Inca city of massive stone walls, terraces and ramps that seem to grow out of the mountainside. It sits in cloud forest above the Urubamba River, within a 35,000-hectare sanctuary that drops from snowfields to tropical rainforest in about twenty kilometres.
